short: The first major Allied offensive against the Empire of Japan, halting their expansion in the Pacific.
full:
On 7 August 1942, Allied forces, primarily United States Marines, landed on Guadalcanal, Tulagi, and Florida in the southern Solomon Islands. Their objective was to deny their use by the Japanese to threaten Allied supply and communication routes between the US, Australia, and New Zealand. The Japanese forces, taken by surprise, launched multiple attempts to retake Henderson Field, resulting in three major land battles, seven large naval battles, and continuous, almost daily aerial combat.

The campaign culminated in the decisive Naval Battle of Guadalcanal in early November 1942, which defeated the last Japanese attempt to bombard Henderson Field and land enough troops to retake it. By 9 February 1943, the remaining Japanese forces evacuated the island, marking a strategic victory for the Allies and initiating their offensive operations toward the Japanese home islands.
